title: THE STATISTICAL VIRIAL: the max-entropy functional vs the virial relation (E2, the spine's one non-Lean rung), attacked from S[rho]
question: can the max-entropy functional at the fixed baryon well C = sqrt(G M_b a0) GENERATE the virial relation sigma^2 = C/2?

el_family.family: rho = A r^(-gamma), gamma = C/sigma^2 (Boltzmann beta = 1/sigma^2)
el_family.reading: the EL is solved to machine precision at gamma = C/sigma^2 for EVERY temperature -- one maximizer per sigma^2; the counting selects no temperature

thermo_identification_per_equilibrium.reading: dS/dE = 1/sigma^2 holds at EVERY equilibrium, each at its own temperature (0.5, 1, 2 x C/2 tested): the multiplier is the inverse temperature as a consistency, selecting no temperature

no_selection_sigma2.reading: at fixed shape dS/dsigma^2 = -(3/2)/sigma^2 < 0 (the self-gravitating microcanonical signature); from both directions the entropy cannot pin sigma^2

direction.reading: rho = A/r^2 is the maximizer iff sigma^2 = C/2: the virial temperature is upstream of the phantom, not downstream

part1_derivation_attempt.verdict: V1 THE DERIVATION ATTEMPT DOES NOT CLOSE (naive direction): the EL of the max-entropy problem at the fixed well yields the family rho = A r^(-C/sigma^2) -- one maximizer per temperature, all solving the EL to machine precision (0.25-2x C/2 tested) -- and the stationarity of the maximum (dS = 0 at fixed M, E) selects the profile for a GIVEN sigma^2, not a value of sigma^2: at every equilibrium (0.5, 1, 2 x C/2 tested) the identification dS/dE = 1/sigma^2 holds at that equilibrium's OWN temperature -- the multiplier IS the inverse temperature purely as a consistency, selecting no temperature -- and at fixed shape dS/dsigma^2 = -(3/2)/sigma^2 < 0 (the negative-signature of the self-gravitating microcanonical sphere; the counter-slope of the EL family dS/dE = +1/sigma^2 exists per equilibrium, both directions carry no extremum in sigma^2).  The phantom rho = A/r^2 is the maximizer AT sigma^2 = C/2 and at no other temperature -- the virial temperature is a PREMISE of the phantom, not an output of the EL.  The statistics converts the temperature into the profile; it does not generate the virial.

Then sigma^2 = C/gamma (an exact inversion), and at the phantom closure gamma = 2 (rho = A/r^2, the equilibrium's isothermal profile -- Lean-certified M01/G227/C07/EQUILIBRIUM_THEORY, measured p = 2.000 at the MW interior, G072/G188): sigma^2 = C/2 = (1/2) sqrt(G M_b a0) -- the spine's rung E2 closes as pure algebra {max-entropy EL identity} x {certified phantom slope}. verdicts.V3: V3 THE HONEST STATEMENT -- THE STATISTICAL VIRIAL EXISTS IN REDUCED FORM, AND THE VIRIAL'S BALANCE IS A GENUINELY SEPARATE PHYSICS INPUT: the max-entropy functional at the fixed well derives the profile from the temperature (rho = A r^(-C/sigma^2), EL-exact at every sigma^2) and -- inverted -- the temperature from the profile (sigma^2 = C/gamma), so that with the phantom slope gamma = 2, E2 = sigma^2 = sqrt(G M_b a0)/2 lands as a theorem of the max-entropy state (Lean-ready, compiled).
